title: Phase — Deliver / wrap-up
description: After green verify: controlled handoff — PR, docs, ticket. Per team policy (may be skipped on the parent workflow).

steps.title: PR summary, docs if needed, ticket status
steps.notes: (1) Summarize commit/PR: goal, how to test, risks; link issue/task. (2) If the feature changes public contract or ops flow: README, OpenAPI, short ADR (same intent as optional docs step). (3) Update tracker (Done, Ready for QA, …) per team convention. Create DELIVER.md for handoff / deferred-scope notes (phase.deliver.final).

steps.title: Update docs (when API / behavior changes)
steps.notes: If the feature changes public contract or ops flow: README, OpenAPI, short ADR. Skip if already covered in handoff or no doc change.
